candidate_space: WO2018173768-inspired PPG/4,4-MDI constrained grid (PUR_SIM_V1, synthetic; 58 blends x 16 NCO:OH points = 928 candidates)

objective.reason: eta80, eta120 and eta80/eta120 are algebraically dependent. Use eta120 plus thermal sensitivity ratio as the two independent objective coordinates; keep eta80 as a processing-window gate.

layers.L0_property: argmin J_state over all candidates, no constraints
layers.L1_constrained: argmin J_state over candidates passing the point-response rheology windows, NCO:OH, MDI-fraction and chemistry-domain gates
layers.L2_robust: strict interval certification over L1: all actual lower/upper response intervals lie inside the preferred windows and domain_ratio <= 1; if the robust set is empty, no winner is assigned and a reachability gap is reported

robustness.ranking_if_nonempty: minimax worst-case normalized J_state over the actual response intervals
robustness.rationale: The latest Database-For-PUR audit showed that strict preferred-window containment is unreachable for the frozen PUR_SIM_V1 uncertainty definition. The scientific result is therefore an empty robust set plus a quantitative reachability gap, not an artificial L2 winner.

backward.manifold: mdi_parts = k_blend * nco_oh (exact on the frozen grid)

local_trends.evaluated_at: robust_winner if one exists; otherwise constrained_winner
local_trends.nco_axis: increasing NCO:OH along the same blend
local_trends.composition_axis: increasing parts of the higher-MDI-demand component within the same two-component family at fixed NCO:OH

expected_from_database_audit.note: These values are provenance/audit references only and must be stripped from blind bundles. They are not inputs to the Agent.
